name: GLOWING WATER
text: The harbor water glows with an unnatural,
vibrant cyan light. Whatever causes the
luminescence seems evenly dispersed beneath
the surface.

name: RUSTED CARGO BARGE
text: A heavy transport vessel moored tightly to the
dock. Its hull is streaked with rust, and the
deck is packed with wooden crates.

name: HEAVY HARBOR CRANE
text: An aging, stationary crane equipped with a
heavy hook. The metal cab is weathered, but
the support structure looks sturdy enough for
heavy lifting.

name: FISH STALL
text: A covered market stall displaying the day's
catch. Dried fish hang from the corrugated tin
roof, while fresh ones sit on ice in wooden
boxes below.

name: STACKED WOODEN CRATES
text: A haphazard pile of wooden shipping crates and
barrels waits on the concrete pier. The wood
is worn, suggesting they've been reused many
times.

name: NARROW WATER GAP
text: A sliver of the glowing harbor water is
visible between the barge's hull and the edge
of the wooden pier. The bright liquid gently
laps against the dark wood and rusty metal.

name: TANGLED FISHING NETS
text: A heap of netting bundled up near the edge of
the concrete walkway. Several orange and blue
floats are tangled within the mesh.

name: BUNDLED FISHING GEAR
text: More netting and buoys are piled near the edge
of the lower pier. The gear looks well-used
and ready for the next trip out.

name: HANGING NETTING
text: A heavy net is draped over the side of the
fish stall. It's partially gathered and
secured against the wooden frame.

name: WOODEN BARRELS
text: Two sturdy wooden barrels sit near a stack of
small crates. The iron hoops holding them
together are stained with rust.

name: MOORING ROPES
text: Thick ropes trail from a wooden crate across
the concrete, ending in a coiled pile near a
mooring cleat.

name: GLOWING HARBOR WATER
text: The bright cyan water laps against the wooden
supports of the pier. The glow creates a sharp
contrast against the dark wood of the pilings.

name: MOORING CLEAT AND ROPE
text: A heavy metal cleat is bolted to the edge of
the lower dock. A thick rope is wrapped
securely around it, holding something taut
off-screen.

name: MOORING ROPE
text: A thick, braided line stretches taut from a
bollard on the pier down toward the water. It
secures the heavy barge to the dock.
